item.title: DHS defends investigating agency critics and giving them warning notices
item.description: Federal officials acknowledged that ICE special agents tracked a New York man to his house, the airport and a hotel to question him about a critical email he sent to the former head of ICE in January.

item.title: USS Washington to relieve USS Lincoln. And, Jared Kushner to meet with Netanyahu
item.description: The USS Washington is on its way to the Middle East to relieve the USS Lincoln amid concerns about conditions aboard. And, Jared Kushner is expected to meet with Prime Minister Netanyahu to move Gaza talks forward.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Hayden Panettiere, who starred in 'Heroes' and 'Nashville,' dies at 36
item.description: A child actor since she was cast in various commercials as an 11-month-old, Panettiere was best known for her role as the country music star Juliette Barnes in the series "Nashville."

item.title: Missed shifts were costly to this McDonald's. An app has fixed the problem
item.description: Unexpected absences can cost employers tens of thousands of dollars a month. An app that helps workers with last-minute transportation, food and childcare is making a difference.

item.title: Meta heads to court in a landmark trial about kids and social media addiction
item.description: Four states are suing the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, alleging that the platforms were designed to hook kids and that Meta hid the mental health risks.

item.title: Advocates worry new bans on student IDs will trip up younger voters
item.description: New bans on using student IDs for voting in Indiana and New Hampshire have sparked lawsuits after creating the latest hurdles to the ballot box for the U.S. voting-age group least likely to vote.

item.title: As wildfires get worse, some states are struggling to pass fire protection rules
item.description: There's a lot homeowners can do to prepare for wildfires, such as managing flammable plants and using fire-resistant building materials. But some states struggle to pass rules requiring those steps.

item.title: Living with nuns: Priced out of D.C., young women found low rent with unlikely roommates
item.description: For 10 years, a Catholic-run home offered young women an affordable place to live in the nation's capital as they studied and launched careers. Now, that community is saying goodbye.

item.title: Cialis is an erectile dysfunction drug. Could it also help you live longer?
item.description: In some wellness circles, tadalafil is promoted as a longevity drug. There is evidence showing a link between it and a lower risk of death in men, but there are no well-controlled trials in humans.
